blocklist.description: List of extension IDs to blocklist (e.g., ['{bad-id@example.com}']). Empty list allows all non-blocklisted extensions.

disable_app_update.description: If true, disables Firefox ESR application updates (e.g., managed via OS package manager).

disable_firefox_accounts.description: If true, disables Firefox Accounts integration (sync, purchase, support).

homepage_new_tab_same_as_start.description: If true, homepage and new tab page both use the configured URL. Otherwise, new tab shows default (e.g., Top Sites).

homepage_url.description: Homepage URL(s) — a single URL string (e.g., 'https://internal.company.com') or list (e.g., ['https://a.com','https://b.com']).

disable_developer_tools.description: If true, disables Developer Tools (F12, Ctrl+Shift+I, etc.).

disable_firefox_studies.description: If true, disables Firefox Shield studies and experiments.

disable_telemetry.description: If true, disables all telemetry (ping, metrics, crash reports).

dns_over_https_enabled.description: If true, enables DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) via configured provider(s).

dns_over_https_providers.description: List of DoH provider URLs in priority order.

disable_pdfjs.description: If true, disables built-in PDF.js viewer — external handlers will be used.

enable_safe_browsing.description: If true, enables Google Safe Browsing (phishing/malware site protection).

proxy_https_host.description: HTTPS proxy host (optional; if blank, falls back to HTTP proxy).

proxy_no_proxy.description: List of hosts to bypass proxy for (comma-separated in rendered config).

proxy_share.description: If true, use the same proxy for all protocols (HTTP/HTTPS/FTP).

proxy_autoconfig_url.description: URL to PAC file (e.g., 'http://proxy.company.com/wpad.dat'). Required if proxy_mode = 'autoconfig'.

proxy_use_system.description: If true, use system proxy settings (overrides all other proxy config).

extension_settings.description: Dictionary of extension settings (e.g., permissions, install sources). Use keys like '{extension-id}' with nested objects.

lock_prefs.description: List of preference names (strings) to lock (user cannot modify in about:config).

extensions_install.description: List of extensions to install (URLs to .xpi or add-on IDs like 'uBlock0@raymondhill.net').

extensions_locked.description: List of extensions to lock (cannot be removed or disabled).

search_bar_enabled.description: If true, enables the search bar (deprecated in recent Firefox but still supported in policies).

default_search_engine.description: Default search engine name (must match internal engine ID, e.g., 'google', 'ddg', 'bing').

disable_browser_reset.description: If true, disables 'Reset Firefox' from about:support.

disable_accounts.description: If true, skips first-run account activation.

captive_portal_enabled.description: If true, enables captive portal detection (disable in locked-down or isolated networks).
